analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($74.82) vs SMA5/20/50 ($65.69/$68.97/$74.72) — Diagnosing short-to-mid-term trend above moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($65.87/$59.32) — Indicating strong mid-to-long-term trend.

· RSI trajectory (35.7→56.4) + Confirmed exit from oversold + Upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.1438→0.5700) + Diagnosed improvement + Potential trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $68.97) + Interpreting normal band width.
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing Support ($70.96) + Based on Pivot S1 and moving averages.
· Swing Resistance ($79.68) + Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low confirmed) + Strengthening uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.90x) + Normal confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + Buy entry condition upon breaking $75.
